package ixgo

import (
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"

	"golang.org/x/tools/go/ssa"
)

// Installed by the external test package to avoid an ixgo -> sandbox import
// cycle. A migration failure panics so expected interpreter errors cannot hide it.
var SandboxTestRoundTrip func(func())

func SandboxTestRunFile(ctx *Context, filename string, src interface{}, args []string) (int, error) {
	pkg, err := ctx.LoadFile(filename, src)
	if err != nil {
		return 2, err
	}
	return SandboxTestRunPkg(ctx, pkg, filename, args)
}

func SandboxTestRun(ctx *Context, path string, args []string) (int, error) {
	if strings.HasSuffix(path, ".go") {
		return SandboxTestRunFile(ctx, path, nil, args)
	}
	pkg, err := ctx.LoadDir(path, false)
	if err != nil {
		return 2, err
	}
	if !isMainPkg(pkg) {
		return 2, ErrNotFoundMain
	}
	return SandboxTestRunPkg(ctx, pkg, path, args)
}

func SandboxTestRunPkg(ctx *Context, pkg *ssa.Package, input string, args []string) (int, error) {
	interp, err := ctx.NewInterp(pkg)
	if err != nil {
		return 2, err
	}
	defer interp.UnsafeRelease()
	return SandboxTestRunInterp(ctx, interp, input, args)
}

func SandboxTestRunInterp(ctx *Context, interp *Interp, input string, args []string) (code int, err error) {
	SandboxTestRoundTrip(func() { code, err = ctx.RunInterp(interp, input, args) })
	return
}

func SandboxTestRunMain(interp *Interp) (code int, err error) {
	SandboxTestRoundTrip(func() { code, err = interp.RunMain() })
	return
}

func SandboxTestRunInit(interp *Interp) (err error) {
	SandboxTestRoundTrip(func() { err = interp.RunInit() })
	return
}

func SandboxTestInterpRunFunc(interp *Interp, name string, args ...Value) (value Value, err error) {
	SandboxTestRoundTrip(func() { value, err = interp.RunFunc(name, args...) })
	return
}

func SandboxTestContextRunFunc(ctx *Context, pkg *ssa.Package, name string, args ...Value) (Value, error) {
	interp, err := ctx.NewInterp(pkg)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return SandboxTestInterpRunFunc(interp, name, args...)
}

func SandboxTestRunTest(ctx *Context, dir string, args []string) error {
	pkg, err := ctx.LoadDir(dir, true)
	if err != nil {
		if err == ErrNoTestFiles {
			return nil
		}
		return err
	}
	if filepath.IsAbs(dir) {
		wd, err := os.Getwd()
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := os.Chdir(dir); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		defer os.Chdir(wd)
	}
	code, err := SandboxTestRunPkg(ctx, pkg, dir, args)
	if err != nil || code != 0 {
		return ErrTestFailed
	}
	return nil
}
